trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest production release) was failing health checks with an 18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. The most recent previously healthy release was **v2.3.0**.

**Rollback:**
- First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on the bad version.
- Retried the rollback, which completed successfully in all three regions.
- Verified post-rollback: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0002** (SEV2) — the on-call engineer has been paged. The incident notes the v2.3.1 failure, the partial-then-complete rollback, and that v2.3.1 remains unhealthy and should not be redeployed until root cause is investigated. (The initial incident-creation request timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to avoid duplicating the incident — the retry succeeded.)
